cold_export_source_target_identity.scope: Direct comparison of separately completed cold full-mode exports. This does not identify an unlogged clock-mode target hash or establish a repair.

limitations: The fixed-trajectory diagnostic covariance comparisons do not establish an accepted orbit covariance or full nonlinear convergence.
This audit does not admit a native whole fit or establish useful performance; that decision remains separate from fixed-trajectory correctness.
Elapsed times and iteration counts are measured single attempts in this frozen protocol, not general performance guarantees.

matched_measurements.timing_scope: One measured attempt per frozen treatment; no statistical speedup claim. Clock warm targets use the prescribed full-mode cold target baseline. Correctness acceptance is distinct from useful performance.
